question: The least bond to depth s over all descending paths of copies: for how many families is it bounded along some path, and does any grow along every path?

definitions.object: L_path, the census ray DP with the middle step a min over which SELF call continues; L_any <= L_path <= L_ray; L_any <= L_true

public_inputs.code: written by Codex in codex/ from the spec; the reach-census code, dlang.py and LIMIT-STATE read-only.
public_inputs.run: codex exec with the spec; the full run launched by the thread from Codex's runner.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the spec, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: the over-paths class per family and L_path(s), joined to draws: weight bands per cell.
cheapest_meaningful_control: the reach census's L_ray (G-reg, G-last) and an independent flattened brute force (G-brute).
validation_gate: G-last, G-brute, G-node of the pre-registration; any failure invalidates the run.

predictions.P1: first-ray growth bounded over paths in >=75% by count (and a weight majority), excluding the 224
predictions.P2: some c>=2 symmetry-inequivalent family grows along every path (count reported)
predictions.P3: some family has a bond only off the first ray

stop_rule: One Codex hand-off, one full run by the thread, its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
